Subject invariants: pale buttery blonde twin tails with coral pink inner sections and cyan-blue tips; charcoal black triangular cat-ear headphones edged in yellow; pink magenta eyes; asymmetrical blonde fringe, tiny cyan zigzag hair clip and pink character hair clip; white sailor-inspired collar with dark trim. Keep her recognizable, adorable and faithful to the supplied reference. Big expressive head, compact upper torso, two simple hands visibly holding the lower left and right edges of ONE open cream-colored book.

Style: clean Japanese chibi cel illustration, confident thick dark charcoal outlines, simplified color blocks, minimal soft shading, crisp finished edges, appealing balanced geometry. High clarity when reduced to 64px.
Backdrop: one rounded-square tile occupying 84 percent of the 1024x1024 canvas, centered with 8 percent transparent outer margins; subtle warm coral-to-vermilion gradient (#E8745A toward #B8442C) consistent with existing app identity. All character art sits inside the rounded tile. Actual alpha transparency outside tile. Interior clean, at most two tiny quiet sparkles.
No text, letters, watermark, logos, collage, mockup, circular portrait crop, busy confetti, original pink splash background, photorealism or 3D. Output ONE standalone 1024x1024 PNG icon.
